description: This Scala source file defines the KubernetesClientUtils object, a utility class for Kubernetes operations within Apache Spark's Kubernetes deployment, including configuration map creation, file handling, and resource management.

classes.name: KubernetesClientUtils
classes.description: A utility object providing methods for managing Kubernetes ConfigMaps, configuration files, and related resources for Spark on Kubernetes.

methods.name: configMapName
methods.description: Generates a Kubernetes config map name with a maximum length constraint.

methods.name: buildStringFromPropertiesMap
methods.description: Converts a map of properties into a Java Properties string.

methods.name: buildSparkConfDirFilesMapJava
methods.description: Builds a Java Map of Spark configuration files and their contents.

methods.name: buildSparkConfDirFilesMap
methods.description: Builds a Map of Spark configuration files and their contents, including resolved properties.

methods.name: buildKeyToPathObjectsJava
methods.description: Creates Java List of KeyToPath objects from a configuration files map.

methods.name: buildKeyToPathObjects
methods.description: Creates a sequence of KeyToPath objects from a configuration files map.

methods.name: buildConfigMapJava
methods.description: Builds a ConfigMap object for Kubernetes from Java Maps.

methods.name: buildConfigMap
methods.description: Builds a Kubernetes ConfigMap object from Scala Maps.

methods.name: orderFilesBySize
methods.description: Orders files by size and name for consistent processing.

methods.name: loadSparkConfDirFiles
methods.description: Loads Spark configuration files from the specified directory, respecting size constraints.
